about: Session 3057 (chain 166): 30 stored policy_actions rows and the record each belongs to, written by the session from each row's own words (its title, its first paragraph and the docket it names). Two documents are one record when they name the same proceeding: a FERC docket (an amendment's -001 with its -000), a hydro project's numbered proceeding, an NRC docket ID (NRC-YYYY-NNNN), an EPA rulemaking docket, a DOE LNG docket, an OSMRE program amendment. A bureau's billing code, which many unrelated documents carry, and an NRC plant's license docket (50-261), which spans unrelated matters, make no record. Records named s1 to s7 stand alone.

items.title: Implementing Section 50203 of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act
items.status: Notice of land available for coal leasing.
items.first_paragraph: Pursuant to section 50203 of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA), enacted on July 4, 2025, the Secretary of the Interior is making available for coal leasing approximately 13,103,000 acres of Federal mineral estate. The OBBBA directs the Secretary of the Interior to make available for coal leasing a minimum of 4,000,000 additional acres of the Federal mineral estate within 90 days of enactment.
